fields.name: FinanceTransactionId
fields.label: Finance Transaction ID
fields.inlineHelpText: Parent finance transaction for the snapshot. The snapshot's fields inherit the transaction's values only if the finance transaction's reference entity type is an invoice, payment, credit memo, debit memo, or refund.

fields.name: ReferenceEntityId
fields.label: ReferenceEntity ID
fields.inlineHelpText: The financial object that was created or updated as a result of a customer action

fields.name: ReferenceEntityType
fields.label: Reference Entity Type
picklistValues: Credit memo line invoice line application
Debit memo line credit memo application
Debit memo line credit memo line application
Debit memo line invoice line application

fields.name: ChargeAmount
fields.label: Charge Amount
fields.inlineHelpText: The charge contributing to the transaction's subtotal

fields.name: AdjustmentAmount
fields.label: Adjustment Amount
fields.inlineHelpText: The adjustment contributing to the transaction's subtotal

fields.name: Subtotal
fields.label: Subtotal
fields.inlineHelpText: Total of the charge amount and adjustment. Doesn't include the tax amount.

fields.name: TaxAmount
fields.label: Tax Amount
fields.inlineHelpText: The total amount of tax for the change made to your reference entity as a result of the event action

fields.name: TotalAmountWithTax
fields.label: Total Amount With Tax
fields.inlineHelpText: The subtotal plus the tax amount

fields.name: ImpactAmount
fields.label: Impact Amount
fields.inlineHelpText: The finance transaction's impact on the customer's finances

fields.name: Balance
fields.label: Balance
fields.inlineHelpText: Final balance of the snapshot's reference entity. Inherited from the finance transaction's resulting balance if the finance transaction's reference entity is a credit memo, debit memo, invoice, payment, or refund.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.label: Account ID
fields.inlineHelpText: Parent account of the reference entity

fields.name: TransactionDate
fields.label: Transaction Date
fields.inlineHelpText: The date when the finance transaction occurred

fields.name: EffectiveDate
fields.label: Effective Date
fields.inlineHelpText: The date when the financial transaction takes effect

fields.name: DueDate
fields.label: Due Date
fields.inlineHelpText: Date when the invoice is due

fields.name: BaseCurrencyIsoCode
fields.label: Base Currency ISO Code
fields.inlineHelpText: Currency of the country defined for this account. Define this value to use later when you calculate currency conversions.

fields.name: BaseCurrencyFxRate
fields.label: Base Currency FX Rate
fields.inlineHelpText: Rate of exchange according to the Base Currency FX Date. Define this value to use later when you calculate currency conversions.

fields.name: BaseCurrencyFxDate
fields.label: Base Currency FX Date
fields.inlineHelpText: Date used to determine the foreign exchange rate. Define this value to use later when you calculate currency conversions.

fields.name: BaseCurrencyAmount
fields.label: Base Currency Amount
fields.inlineHelpText: Define this value based on any currency conversion needed for the total amount with tax.

fields.name: BaseCurrencyBalance
fields.label: Base Currency Balance
fields.inlineHelpText: Define this value based on any currency conversion needed for the resulting balance.

fields.name: LegalEntityId
fields.label: Legal Entity ID
fields.inlineHelpText: Legal entity associated with the finance transaction. This is an optional lookup that you can add to associate the finance transaction to GL rules for external ledger processing.

fields.name: OriginalReferenceEntityType
fields.label: Original Reference Entity Type
fields.inlineHelpText: The finance transaction's reference entity type when the finance transaction was created.

fields.name: OriginalEventType
fields.label: Original Event Type
fields.inlineHelpText: The finance transaction's event type when the finance transaction was created.

fields.name: FinanceSystemName
fields.label: Finance System Name
fields.inlineHelpText: The name of the external financial system used to recognize the finance transaction.

fields.name: FinanceSystemIntegrationMode
fields.label: Finance System Integration Mode
fields.inlineHelpText: The type of the external financial system used to recognize the finance transaction.
